card.text: Young Sun-like star 52 parsecs away whose magnetic field flipped between 2013 and 2017.

sources.label: Willamo et al. 2022
sources.quote: Of special interest is the case of V1358 Ori, which had gone through a polarity reversal between our observations and earlier ones.

introduction.text: V1358 Orionis is a young Sun-like star that turns in 33 hours. Between its maps of 2013 and 2017, its magnetic field flipped.

sources.label: Willamo et al. 2022
sources.quote: The most interesting feature in the maps is the polarity reversal, which occurred between 2013 and 2017.
